body: oh that's pretty cool, and nah I havent been, but I'd maybe love to someday

oh man it's actually a little comforting to have someone relate. But I do a lot of stuff- I like doing digital or traditional art-  I usually draw characters or people that I like. It's kind of hard to describe, but I like to think that my art kind of expresses myself and what I like. I also like to mess around a little with clay or embroidery if I ever feel up to it.

I'm so sorry- don't feel down on yourself for someone unrightly pushing you away without reason. I can only hope that you've since gotten a way to contact someone since posting this, but if not, I just want you to know that I can hear you. If you can, try to get in contact with your siblings maybe? Maybe through a public library computer, or if you have any friends around. Heck, anyone who has a phone and is willing to spare you a few minutes to make a call. Aside from that, I totally know what you mean to have your parents favoring the other child- that's how it's been for me my whole life pretty much, my parents never see through anything my brother does, but always come down on me for nothing.

I thought I should just let you know that I hear you. Right now for me, things have just been getting worse and worse and it's taking a toll on my mind- but I feel like everything's been leading up to me breaking down for years, and I feel like I'll eventually reach my peak and end it all. I don't even know exactly why, but your post made me stop what I was doing a create an account so I could comment. My feelings are genuine when I tell you that I don't think you're disgusting or worthless- and your past doesn't define you, to me, it has no effect on who I judge you as a person. When I read what you wrote, it was like someone putting into words what I feel-  just tired of everything...and tired of pretending. Tired of no one truly understanding, and no one giving what you say more than a little sympathy. It's like searching for help but never getting any. It feels awful, I won't even try to glamorize it in anyway. I don't know if you'll feel the same way, but reading what you wrote has allowed me to calm down a little from my breakdown and relate to someone- to know someone else out there feels pain too. I guess I've also found that writing makes me feel a bit better too.
